en: The postcard depicts a neoclassical building with two stories, arched windows and doors on the ground floor, ornamental details, and a sign reading 'FAZENDA' above the central entrance. The building stands on a spacious paved area with a few trees and a smaller structure in the background. The caption at the top reads: 'Lourenço Marques. Edificio da Fazenda – Revenue Office.'
